## ✅ Review checklist

- [ ] Existing report and source files are preserved.
- [ ] KPI definitions and filter context are documented.
- [ ] PBIX opens and refreshes successfully, when report files changed.
- [ ] Visual labels, formatting, and accessibility were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation links were checked.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data were added.
- [ ] Claims and screenshots reflect the actual report.
